about: A length of call time chosen for a seat, by the member from the seat or by the floor's Add call time (the owner, 18 Nov; #1076). One rule for both. Lengths are whole minutes from 1 to 1,440 (which the club offers is its setting, call_time.add_choices, checked apart from this rule). Until a call time is set, the length counts from now: the seat's call time becomes the whole minutes played (floored; none or below nought counting as nought) plus the length, and only a length ending strictly after the call time the seat started with is open, never one ending before the call time owed now. Once set, a length extends it: it is added whole to the later of the call time and the whole minutes played, so more chosen after it ran out counts from now. Only a seat with a call time (more than nought minutes) sets or extends one. A call time is at most a day, 1,440 minutes, in all. The database's private.call_time_choice_end is proved equal on these cases and refuses with null.

cases.description: Not set: two hours chosen an hour and forty minutes into a three-hour call time make three hours forty.
Not set: an hour chosen two hours into a three-hour call time would end just as it does, not after it, and is refused.
Not set: an hour chosen two hours and a minute in ends a minute after the three hours, and is open.
Not set: an hour chosen an hour and forty minutes in would end before the three hours, and is refused.
Not set and past the three hours: thirty minutes chosen four hours in count from now, four and a half hours.
Not set: minutes played below nought count as nought, so four hours chosen at the start make four hours.
Not set, with time the floor added before (four hours, from three): three and a half hours an hour in would cut it down, and is refused.
Set: an hour extends a four-hour call time an hour and a half in to five hours.
Set and already run out: thirty minutes chosen five hours into a four-hour call time count from now, five and a half hours.
Not set: an hour chosen twenty-three hours and twenty minutes in would pass a day, and is refused.
Set: an hour added to a call time of twenty-three hours and twenty minutes would pass a day, and is refused.
A seat with no call time sets none.
More than a day is not a length.
Nought minutes is not a length, set or not.
Not set: an hour chosen twenty-three hours in ends at a day exactly, and is open.
Not set, with time the floor added before (four hours, from three): two hours chosen two hours in end just as it does, and are open.
